stem.text: In the Contact process, sulfur dioxide and oxygen react to form sulfur trioxide.
In the Haber process, nitrogen and hydrogen react to form ammonia.
Which statement about these processes is correct?

A.text: $K_\text{p}$ for the Haber process has no unit.

B.text: In the Contact process, the value of $K_\text{p}$ falls when pressure is increased at constant $T$.

C.text: The Haber process uses a homogeneous catalyst.

D.text: When $\text{V}_2\text{O}_5$ is used in the Contact process, the position of equilibrium is unchanged.
